Here is the final recap for the **Summer Relief Petition** campaign (`6yrpn`), which ran across the five-day flight from **Friday, July 16, 2027 through Tuesday, July 20, 2027** (Pacific Time, `2027-07-16T07:00:00Z` – `2027-07-21T07:00:00Z`).

---

###Headline Campaign Summary

| Metric | Result |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Total Spend** | **$983.40 USD** (`983,399,018` micros; 98.34% of the $1,000.00 budget) |
| **Impressions** | **763,792** (Unique Reach: **744,689** · Avg. Frequency: **1.03**) |
| **Link Clicks** | **237** |
| **Total Engagements** | **5,111** (237 link clicks, 124 likes, 3 reposts, 1 reply) |
| **Average Cost per Link Click (CPC)** | **$4.15** |
| **Link Click-Through Rate (CTR)** | **0.0310%** |

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

Every ad group was configured for `WEBSITE_CLICKS` (`goal=LINK_CLICKS`, `pay_by=LINK_CLICK`, `placements=ALL_ON_TWITTER`, `audience_expansion=DEFINED`) and strictly targeted **United States** (`96683cc9126741d1`) residents aged **18 and older** (`AGE_OVER_18`) in compliance with both your petition eligibility policy and X's `political_campaigning` policy.

| `e26c0` | **US 18+ \| Urban & Public Access Keywords** | US, 18+, Civic/Restroom Keywords | Both Posts | $132.63 | 114,152 | **32** | 0.0280% | $4.14 | Paused (Day 5) |
| `onot0` | **US 18+ \| Civic & Policy Interests** | US, 18+, News/Politics/Elections/Education | Both Posts | $114.17 | 83,991 | **26** | 0.0310% | $4.39 | Paused (Day 4) |
| `4xbep` | **US 18+ \| Errands, Family & Travel Interests** | US, 18+, Shopping/Travel/Family/Fitness | Both Posts | $49.36 | 48,554 | **11** | 0.0227% | $4.49 | Paused (Day 2) |

| `2208652644972278028` | *"July 20 is the last day to add your name. Sign our Summer Relief Petition for free public toilets..."* | $282.47 | 268,728 | **69** | 0.0257% | **$4.09** |

---

### Flight Management & Optimization Recap

1. **Day 1 (Jul 16 PDT) — Multi-Segment Launch:** Launched four US 18+ ad groups testing Broad National (`x0xab`), Civic & Policy Interests (`onot0`), Urban & Public Access Keywords (`e26c0`), and Errands/Family/Travel Interests (`4xbep`) with both approved posts. Broad National (`x0xab`) immediately led in both CTR (`0.0409%`) and CPC (`$2.50`), while Post `2208471451039109695` (*"Summer errands need a restroom stop..."*) outperformed Post `2208652644972278028` by **50% in link clicks** (`30` vs. `20`).
2. **Day 2 (Jul 17 PDT) — Shifting to High-CTR Broad + Top Creative:** Paused the lowest-performing interest segment (`4xbep`, `0.0227%` CTR / `$4.49` CPC), scaled `x0xab`, and launched a dedicated US 18+ Broad National ad group (`fxsre`) focused exclusively on the winning creative (`2208471451039109695`).
3. **Days 3–5 (Jul 18–20 PDT) — Scaling Winners & Pacing to Budget:** As `x0xab` and `fxsre` continued to deliver the highest click volume and strongest CTR (`0.0360%` overall on `fxsre`), we progressively shifted budget away from the narrower interest/keyword ad groups (`onot0` paused on Day 4; `e26c0` paused on Day 5) and calibrated final-day budgets so the flight finished cleanly at **$983.40** spent and **237 link clicks**.
